deadinternetstudios-100x-engineer-skill-.description: Use when the owner types 100x, with or without a brief, or asks for a prototype worth keeping. Runs one thread from brief to a finished, reviewed, screenshot-proven prototype with a report. A message that starts with 100x is a brief to build, even when the brief holds the name of a mode below as a word, as in '100x a status page'. Number phrases in the brief set the run: 3 versions, for 10 hours, 5 rounds of judging, max 5 subagents. The other modes are skills of their own: 100x-mockup, 100x-wrapup, 100x-overnight, 100x-report, 100x-setup, 100x-continue, 100x-judge, 100x-grind, 100x-solo,…
deadinternetstudios-100x-engineer-skill-.author: DeadInternetStudios

deadinternetstudios-100x-engineer-skill-.description: Use for /100x-adhd, or when the owner wants short back and forth: 'adhd mode', 'go back and forth with me', 'ask me questions', 'talk it through'. Small turns: at most three points, one question, then wait. It answers questions about the project and shapes a loose idea into a brief, one question at a time. Nothing builds until the owner says go.
deadinternetstudios-100x-engineer-skill-.author: DeadInternetStudios

deadinternetstudios-100x-engineer-skill-.description: Use for /100x-bakeoff, or when the owner asks whether 100x makes better prototypes than the same agent without it: 'does 100x help', 'run the bake-off', 'compare with and without the skill'. Runs a blind skill-off against skill-on comparison from the protocol and answers with one honest paragraph and a number. It tests the skill and builds no prototype. A project's own review is 100x-judge.
deadinternetstudios-100x-engineer-skill-.author: DeadInternetStudios

deadinternetstudios-100x-engineer-skill-.description: Use for /100x-continue, or when a 100x run stopped and the owner says to pick it up: 'continue the run', 'resume the 100x run'. A watchdog message asks for the same. Resumes the unfinished run in this folder from its last true state.
deadinternetstudios-100x-engineer-skill-.author: DeadInternetStudios

deadinternetstudios-100x-engineer-skill-.description: Use for /100x-grind, or when the owner wants work judged and fixed until a judge says yes: 'grind it', 'keep going until it is ready to ship', 'do not stop until the judge is happy'. Keeps judge rounds going past the usual count until a fresh judge says ready to ship with no blocker or major finding. A brief builds first. It stops early only when three ship tests in a row bring nothing better, at 15 rounds, or when the clock has no room. Only for a 100x project with judge rounds, never for carrying on an ordinary code task until its tests pass.
deadinternetstudios-100x-engineer-skill-.author: DeadInternetStudios

deadinternetstudios-100x-engineer-skill-.description: Use for /100x-judge, or when the owner wants a second model to judge what 100x already built: 'judge it', 'is this ready to ship'. Runs judge rounds, triage and fixes, and builds nothing new. Stage 6 of a normal build runs these same rounds.
deadinternetstudios-100x-engineer-skill-.author: DeadInternetStudios

deadinternetstudios-100x-engineer-skill-.description: Use for /100x-mockup, or when the owner wants to see an idea as running code fast: 'mock it up', 'just show me'. Only the moment has to work. It runs no judges, takes about 15 minutes and ends UNREVIEWED, and says so on its card and in the final message.
deadinternetstudios-100x-engineer-skill-.author: DeadInternetStudios

deadinternetstudios-100x-engineer-skill-.description: Use for /100x-overnight, or when the owner is leaving and wants finished prototypes waiting: 'while I sleep', 'I'm leaving', 'build these tonight', several briefs at once. Sets the clock, arms the watchdog, runs one brief here or one child per brief, and ends with the report ranking.
deadinternetstudios-100x-engineer-skill-.author: DeadInternetStudios

deadinternetstudios-100x-engineer-skill-.description: Use for /100x-report, or when the owner comes back and asks what 100x finished: 'what got built', 'show me the report', 'morning report'. Ranks the finished runs, says what each is and why the judge held any back, lists the runs still being built, and opens the gallery page. Nothing builds.
deadinternetstudios-100x-engineer-skill-.author: DeadInternetStudios

deadinternetstudios-100x-engineer-skill-.description: Use for /100x-setup, or when the owner wants to choose the models, effort or judge for 100x, or a 100x doctor check says settings are missing. Asks one question, 'which models do which job', sorts the answer into jobs and saves it.
deadinternetstudios-100x-engineer-skill-.author: DeadInternetStudios

deadinternetstudios-100x-engineer-skill-.description: Use for /100x-solo, or when the owner wants a whole 100x run done by this one model in this one chat, with no subagents, no helpers and no second model: 'solo', 'do it all yourself', 'never delegate'. Same pipeline as 100x. It judges its own work in writing at every step, as a stranger would, and says in the report and the final message that nobody else looked.
deadinternetstudios-100x-engineer-skill-.author: DeadInternetStudios

deadinternetstudios-100x-engineer-skill-.description: Use for /100x-status, or when the owner asks where a 100x project is at: 'where are we at', 'explain where this run is'. Answers in at most six lines: stage, done, next, risks, and the one thing waiting on the owner. Nothing builds. Not for git status, build status or the status of any tool but a 100x run.
deadinternetstudios-100x-engineer-skill-.author: DeadInternetStudios

deadinternetstudios-100x-engineer-skill-.description: Use for /100x-wrapup, or when a deadline is close and a project must just work: 'wrap it up', 'I have until 5pm'. The main path runs from a clean start, everything unfinished is hidden or removed cleanly, and a short note says what is what. No new features.
deadinternetstudios-100x-engineer-skill-.author: DeadInternetStudios
